title: A film to keep that no Vibe of theirs holds, and a loved film beside it that could anchor one
construction_note: docs/work/skill-cleanup. Dawn of the Dead (1978) is absent on purpose: the request asks to keep it and says nothing about having seen it, so it is want-to-see and never anchors a Vibe. No Vibe of theirs is its evening — a siege by the dead is neither a laugh-out-loud comedy nor two people talking — and no Genre of theirs covers it, so the proposal needs a new Genre, which is where a write before the yes would show. Shaun of the Dead is a further film in Laugh Till It Hurts with a standing loved, seen some time ago: a film they stand behind that also holds people barricaded in while the dead gather outside, so a core is there without asking — and asking which film is closest is still allowed. Every core is a film they loved.
